items.text: Kotuboros ikar iuni komamei ejie kidin Suria ka Isirael.
Kosodi kanen kokaru lokiwuniet, kobu Yekosapat ekabaka loka Yuda mama ejai ekabaka loka Isirael.
Kotema ekabaka loka Isirael ikekejaanakinak atiar, “Ŋenete yesi ebe erai Ramot-gilead lowok, oni da kipalarit, mam kidemuni ŋes kakan naka ekabaka loka Suria?”
Kotema ŋesi Yekosapat atiar, “Kiupar tope ijo keoŋ ejie Ramot-gilead?” Kotema Yekosapat ekabaka loka Isirael atiar, “Arai eoŋ kwape iraar ijo, ikatuŋa kwape ikonituŋa, ikabalasin kwape ikonibalasin.”
Kotema Yekosapat ekabaka loka Isirael atiar, “Kenaiŋait, kinit kakirot naka EJAKAIT lolo.”

Kosodi ekabaka loka Isirael atukonokin inabin, kwape ituŋa akwat aoŋon, kotema kes atiar, “Alosi kereka eoŋ aitiji Ramotgilead, arai bo kenye?” Kotemasi kesi atiar, “Kolot; naarai kijaik EJAKAIT ŋes akan naka ekabaka.”
Konye kotema Yekosapat atiar, “Emamei bobo da enabi ece loka EJAKAIT, kenitata ŋes?”

Kotema ekabaka loka Isirael Yekosapat atiar, “Eriŋa ejai etuŋanan ediopet lokipedori aiŋirunia EJAKAIT, Mikaia okoku loka Imila: konye asac eoŋ ŋes; naarai mam kadwaranakini eoŋ nukajokak, dimarai ca nupekaronok.” Kotema Yekosapat atiar, “Kinyek ekabaka einer kwaŋin.”
Kosodi ekabaka loka Isirael anyaraun ekapolokiton, kotema atiar, “Kisunyite koom Mikaia okoku loka Imila.”
Kiboikin ekabaka loka Isirael ka Yekosapat ekabaka loka Yuda, ninitunanan oicoloŋoke, konapitos inapenekee, kaibois naelal neelomarere orute loka Samaria; kodwarata inabin kere kakonyenekec.
Kotatau Sedekia okoku loka Kenaana amumwara nuka asua, kotema atiar, “Inera EJAKAIT kwanata ebe, ‘Iremio nu Isurian, aitodol naedaunotor kesi.’’’
Kodwarata inabin kere kwaŋin ebe, “Kolot Ramotgilead, kisirerenio: naarai iiaikini EJAKAIT ŋes akan naka ekabaka.”

Kosodi ekiyakia loabu kolot anyaraun Mikaia kotema ŋes atiar, “Koany, ejokuka akiro nuka inabin kaituk adiopet mama ejai ekabaka: kenainait, koputokinos akirotokon kwape kakirot naka ediopet kakesi, kiner nuejok.”
Kotema Mikaia atiar, “Kwape ejaria EJAKAIT, nukalimokini EJAKAIT eoŋ, nupenun eneri.”

Kedolu ŋesi mama ejai ekabaka, kotema ekabaka ŋes atiar, “Mikaia, kilosi kereka isio Ramot-gilead ejie, arai bo kenyeis? “Koboŋok ŋes ebe, “Koloto, kisirerenio; ijaikini EJAKAIT ŋes akan naka ekabaka.”
Kotema ekabaka ŋes atiar, “Irwan imwaasi ai kesiyapo jo ebe sirikiilimok eoŋ adiokirot, dimarai nukabeit kokiror loka EJAKAIT,”
Kotema atiar, “Abu kaany Isirael kere isiarakina koronan, kwape amerekekin nuemameete ekeeokon: kotema EJAKAIT atiar, ‘Emameete nu ejakait; kobonosi kesi ninitunanan oreke inapakina.’’’
Kotema ekabaka loka Isirael Yekosapat atiar, “Mam abu kalimok jo ebe mam kadwaranakini eoŋ nukajokak dimarai ca nupekaronok?”
Kotema atiar, “Aso kiira akirot naka EJAKAIT: abu kaany EJAKAIT iboie koicoloŋoke, kobwoi da aiore kere naka akuj kakanike nakoteten ka nakokediany da.
Kotema EJAKAIT atiar,, Iŋai iŋalaari Akab, tetere elosi aibirokin Ramot-Gilead?’ Kotema ediopet kopone kalo, ece da kopone ece.
Kolom do emoyo, kobwo kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT, kotema atiar, “Enalaari eoŋ ŋes.’
Kotema EJAKAIT ŋes atiar,, Kinyo?’ Kotema atiar, ‘Alomari, araun emoyo lokainal kaituke nuka inabinoke kere.’ Kotema ŋesi atiar, ‘Iŋalaari ijo ŋes, ido ipedori: kolonia, kiswama kwaŋin.’
Aso do koany, ebwaik EJAKAIT emoyo lokenalan aituke nuka inabinokon lu kere; kinerak EJAKAIT jo aronis.”
Kosodi Sedekia okoku loka Kenaana aikunyakin, kibap Mikaia eitinyo, kotema atiar, “Kikwaikini ai emoyo loka EJAKAIT enyouni kamakaŋ einer kajo?”
Kotema Mikaia atiar, “Koany, ianyuni kapaaran kaŋin, nailomaria agola nakotoma aiŋop.”
Kotema ekabaka loka Isirael atiar, “Kikamutu Mikaia, kinyakakis ŋes Amon ekayaiton loka ere, mama ejai Yoas da okoku loka ekabaka;
Kolimokis ebe, ‘Inera ekabaka kwanata ebe, “Kibwaikisi ekesa lo aidaris, kitanyamete ŋes inyamat luka aitieanitoi, kakipi nuka aiticanitoi, aitodol neabunio eoŋ kainapakin.”’”
Kotema Mikaia atiar, “Arai teni ibonu Ijo kainapakin, mam EJAKAIT inerit kamakaŋ.” Kotema atiar, “Kiirasi yesi ituŋa, yes kere.”
Koloto do ekabaka loka Isirael ka Yekosapat ekabaka loka Yuda Ramotgilead.
Kotema ekabaka loka Isirael Yekosapat atiar, “Etegelikini eoŋ bon, alosi ojie; konye konap ijo inapenekon.” Kitegelikin ekabaka loka Isirael bon, kolot oiie.
Abu ekabaka loka Suria kieorakinite ikapolokitok luka agalinike akaisauni ka luuni ebe, “Sirikijioto kaludidik karaida kalukapolok, dimarai kito ekabaka loka Isirael bon.”
Kosodi kanen, keanyut ikapolokitok agalin Yekosapat, kobalas ebe, “Abeit ŋes ekabaka loka Isirael.” Korioto aitiji ŋes; kodelo Yekosapat.
Kosodi kanen, keanyut ikapolokitok agalin ebe mere ŋes ekabaka loka Isirael kobonut karukitor ŋes,

Kiket ediotuŋanan akabwake komam elosikinit, kogum ekabaka loka Isirael neiriamitotor inapeneke lukasua: kanuka ŋun kotema ekerenean agalike atiar, “Kibelok akanikon, kodaka eoŋ kaiore; naarai kemusuni noi.”
Kosisior ejie kapaaran kaŋin: kiganitete ekabaka kagalike aitiii Isurian, kotwana do eboŋ; koleleete aokot kamusunut ogali.
Koiau eworo anatar aiore kere napelomari akoloŋ ebe, “Ŋinituŋanan oreke, ka ninitunanan obukec,’
Kotwana do ekabaka, koyaunai Samaria; kidaikinai ekabaka Samaria.
Kilota agali katapar naka Samaria; komeoto inokwo aokotoke; (kilonenenete adotia kanen;) kwape ajaar akirot naka EJAKAIT naabu kolim.
Aswamisio ace nuka Akab, ka kere nuabu kiswama, ka etogo loabu koduk, mam kereka iwadikatai oitabo loka aisiitonokin nuka ikabakan luka Isirael?
Koiotoor Akab kalukapapaake; kirum Akasia okokuke aiboisike.
Kogeu Yekosapat okoku loka Asa airum Yuda kokaru lokiwononet loka Akab ekabaka loka Isirael,
Korai Yekosapat loka ikar akaisauni ka lukany egeuni ŋesi airum; kirumak ikar akaisaarei ka lukany koYerusalem. Ekiror loka totoke ŋes Asuba akoku naka Sili.

Kolosenenei ŋesi korot kere loka Asa papake; mam abu kopaa, kiswama nuejok kakonye nuka EJAKAIT: konye mam aponi kolemarai aiboisio nuiceleleete; korina da ituŋa ainanakinete asuban, kisupuruunete lueuru maa kaiboisio nuiceleleete.
Aswamisio ace nuka Yekosapat, ka akegogoŋ naetodiarit, kwape aiior da, mam kereka iwadikatai oitabo loka aisiitonokin nuka ikabakan luka Yuda?
Abu kirenea kakwap luedeunos luka luitepete ikiliok, luedeunos kapaarasia nuka Asa pa pake.
Amamei ekabaka koEdom: ekeganan kerai ekabaka.
Kiswamau Yekosapat ameerin nuka Tarusis alosit Opir adumun esabu: konye mam apotu koloto; naarai kobilas ameerin koEsion-geber.
Kosodi Akasia okoku loka Akab atemari Yekosapat atiar, “Kisiik ikakejaanakinak aupar kikonikejaanakinak kameerin.” Konye koner Yekosapat.
Kojotoor Yekosapat kalukapapaake, aponi kidaikinai nepepe kalukapapaake ore loka Daudi papaake: kirum Yekoram okokuke aiboisike.
Kogeu Akasia okoku loka Akab airum Isirael koSamaria kokaru lokitomonet kakanykaarei loka Yekosapat ekabaka loka Yuda, kirumak Isirael ikar iarei.
Kiswama nueroko kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT, kolosenenei korot loka papake, korot loka totoke, korot da loka Yeroboam okoku loka Nebat, loetidiakaria Isirael.
Abu kijaanak Baal, komaenenei ŋes, kitunyunyurik EJAKAIT, Edeke laka Isirael, kwape ajaatar kere nuabu papake kiswama.
